rule_p3: Two boxes are near-duplicates when each sorted dimension is within 10 %. Two non-box rooms are near-duplicates when their sorted bounding boxes, volumes and surface areas are each within 10 %. A box and a non-box room are not near-duplicates. A room is fresh when it is a near-duplicate of no corpus room.
